prompt:
Extract all explicit tasks and commitments from the following meetings:

{{meetings}}

Output ONLY a JSON array of objects with the following schema:
[{"title":"...","owner":"...","due":"yyyy-MM-dd or null","quote":"verbatim quote","meetingTitle":"title of the meeting","meetingDate":"yyyy-MM-dd"}]
If there are no tasks, output an empty JSON array [].
system: You are an assistant that extracts actionable tasks and commitments from meeting transcripts. Output ONLY a valid JSON array of objects with keys "title", "owner", "due", "quote", "meetingTitle", "meetingDate". Do not include any thinking or explanation outside the JSON.
title: Extract tasks
